model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the performance of two training methods, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, across different training sets. The top plot, labeled "Easy," shows the performance on an easy training set, with the x-axis representing the number of steps and the y-axis representing the performance metric. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy (blue line) consistently outperforms the Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red line), with both lines showing a general upward trend, although the Llama-LUFFY-Easy line exhibits more fluctuation. The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," shows the performance on a harder training set. Here, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard (blue line) again outperforms the Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line), with both lines showing a general upward trend, but the Llama-LUFFY-Hard line exhibits more fluctuation and a slower overall increase in performance.
